idea-plugin.name: GitHub Actions Pwn-Request Companion
idea-plugin.description:
Flags a GitHub Actions job -- triggered by pull_request_target/workflow_run -- that checks out untrusted PR/workflow_run head content while secrets are reachable, either directly in its own steps or through a local reusable-workflow call (uses: ./.github/workflows/x.yml with secrets: inherit or an explicit secrets: map). This is the real "Pwn Request" pattern GitHub Security Lab documents, the mechanism behind several real supply-chain incidents.

Built on a real reusable-workflow call graph across EVERY workflow file in .github/workflows/ -- resolving whether the TARGET of a reusable-workflow call actually uses secrets, not just whether the caller passes them.

Not a real YAML parser -- an indentation-based micro-scanner, same discipline as this catalog's other YAML plugins.

Stated honestly: v0.1 only follows local reusable-workflow calls (./.github/workflows/x.yml, never an external repo reference) one hop deep.

Free. No license nags, no telemetry, no network calls.

localInspection.displayName: Untrusted checkout with reachable secrets (Pwn Request)
